amex platinum.notes: Cardholder + 1 guest free. Unlimited visits. Worldwide via Priority Pass; Amex Centurion Lounge at T3 direct.

amex centurion.notes: Cardholder + unlimited guests. Premium Amex card by invitation.

amex business platinum.notes: Same lounge benefits as personal Platinum.

amex gold.notes: No complimentary Heathrow lounge access (Priority Pass benefit was discontinued).

hsbc premier world elite.notes: Includes DragonPass membership (typically 6 visits/year). Use at Plaza Premium and Aspire/No.1 lounges.

barclays avios plus.notes: BA Avios earning card. No complimentary Heathrow lounge access.

natwest premier reward black.notes: No included lounge access. Cardholders can buy Priority Pass separately.

revolut ultra.notes: Includes LoungeKey passes (limited annual visits, check Revolut for current allowance).

revolut metal.notes: LoungeKey passes via DragonPass partner (limited; check Revolut).

virgin atlantic reward+.notes: 1 complimentary Virgin Atlantic Clubhouse visit per year (T3 Heathrow, departing only). Spend threshold may apply.

chase sapphire reserve.notes: Priority Pass Select — cardholder only after 2025 changes; guests at additional cost.

capital one venture x.notes: Unlimited Priority Pass visits for cardholder + 2 guests.

amex platinum us.notes: Includes Priority Pass + Centurion Lounge access. Cardholder + 2 guests.

priority pass.notes: Direct membership — buy plan from prioritypass.com. Tiers: Standard / Standard Plus / Prestige.

loungekey.notes: Usually bundled with Mastercard premium products; not sold direct.

dragonpass.notes: Direct membership or via cards like HSBC Premier WE Mastercard.
